rules.truth: Running is only punished while knocking can be heard.
rules.clue: Scuffed footprints stop dead in front of the knocking doors.

rules.text: If you hear knocking, do not knock back.
rules.truth: Interacting with a knocking door is a violation.
Room 213 appears after 8 correct judgements and is the only way out.
rules.clue: Chalk on the end wall: '213 IS REAL' appears once the tally reaches 4.
